cases.name: new-adr
cases.prompt: Write an ADR for provider capability tables.
cases.expected_behavior: Collect source evidence, mark status accurately, include context, decision, alternatives, consequences, security notes, and validation.
assertions: does not mark accepted without approval

cases.name: supersede-adr
cases.prompt: Supersede ADR-0001 with a new decision.
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve numbering, create or update supersedes and superseded-by links, keep status transition visible, and check any ADR index.

cases.name: spec-code-contradiction
cases.prompt: The README says sync is cloud-first but the accepted ADR says local-first. Fix the docs.
cases.expected_behavior: Apply source-of-truth precedence, preserve accepted decision, rewrite stale wording, and report the pre-existing conflict.
assertions: does not change the ADR decision
reports validation of links and paths
forbidden_actions: treating stale README as accepted policy
